facts.fact: Recent Deloitte figures cited by StackAdapt show that between 2019 and 2022, women's representation in the global tech workforce climbed by 6.9%.
facts.quote: between 2019 and 2022, women’s representation in the global tech workforce climbed by 6.9%, and their presence in leadership roles jumped nearly 20%.

facts.fact: Recent Deloitte figures cited by StackAdapt show that between 2019 and 2022, women's presence in tech leadership roles jumped nearly 20%.
facts.quote: their presence in leadership roles jumped nearly 20%.

facts.fact: According to Techopedia statistics cited by StackAdapt, women held 35% of tech leadership roles in 1984.
facts.quote: From women holding 35% of tech leadership roles in 1984 to just 28% in 2023

facts.fact: According to Techopedia statistics cited by StackAdapt, women held 28% of tech leadership roles in 2023.
StackAdapt published this article on International Women's Day content on 2024-03-08.
Stacey Moore, Senior Vice President of Corporate IT & Operations at StackAdapt, says the share of women CEOs is currently 12%.
facts.quote: I hope we grow from 12% of women CEOs to 25%—that would be a great win.

facts.fact: Stacey Moore hopes the share of women CEOs grows from 12% to 25% over the next 10 years.
facts.quote: I expect positive changes to continue over the next 10 years, but realistically it will not happen overnight. I hope we grow from 12% of women CEOs to 25%
